source_principale: data-lake/BR/10K/BR_2026-08-04.htm.gz (10-K FY2026, exercice clos le 30 juin 2026)

controles.verbatim_source: Legal Proceedings Currently, there are no material pending legal proceedings, other than ordinary routine litigation incidental to the business, to which the Company is a party or of which any of the Company's property is the subject.

controles.affirmation: JURIDIQUE/REGLEMENTAIRE - balayage adversarial : aucune enquete, poursuite, amende, sanction, antitrust ou fraude n'est affirmee dans l'ATT
controles.verbatim_source: Aucune occurrence de DOJ, subpoena, enforcement action, antitrust ou penalty en cours dans le 10-K FY2026. Les 11 mentions de FINRA sont purement descriptives du cadre reglementaire (BBPO, filiale broker-dealer, membre FINRA, Uniform Net Capital Rule 15c3-1). Les 2 occurrences de 'investigations' sont hypothetiques dans les facteurs de risque ('could give rise to ... regulatory investigations').

controles.affirmation: HOOK - benefice net +34% et 227 M$ de gain non monetaire sur cryptoactifs, classe en point cle de l'audit
controles.verbatim_source: Net earnings $ 1,124.3 $ 839.5 (soit +33,9%) ; 'Other non-operating income, net for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2026 was $245.2 million, compared to Other non-operating expenses, net of $7.1 million for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2025, primarily as a result of non-cash Gains on Digital Assets of $227.0 million' ; 'We identified digital assets as a critical audit matter due to the nature and extent of audit effort required to obtain sufficient appropriate audit evidence...' ; 'Additionally, we identified the accounting treatment of the digital assets and their presentation and disclosure as a critical audit matter due to the complexity and subjectivity of the transactions'
controles.correction_proposee: Nuance possible : la hausse du resultat net est de 284,8 M$, le gain de 227,0 M$ est un montant avant impot (l'impact fiscal des ajustements FY2026 est nul dans la reconciliation, donc l'ordre de grandeur tient).

controles.affirmation: FONDAMENTAL 1 - resultat net 1 124,3 vs 839,5 M$ (+34%), resultat operationnel 1 300,6 vs 1 188,6 M$ (+9%)
FONDAMENTAL 1 - le gain de 227,0 M$ est qualifie de 'non recurrent'
controles.verbatim_source: Le 10-K dit uniquement 'non-cash Gains on Digital Assets of $227.0 million'. Le mot non-recurring / one-time n'apparait jamais a propos de ce gain. Au contraire, les Canton Coins sont gagnes de facon continue via le role de Validator et Super Validator, sont evalues a la juste valeur a chaque cloture selon ASC 350-60 ('accounts for these digital assets at fair value with changes in fair value recognized in net income'), et generent des revenus recurrents ('Digital asset revenues related to Canton Coins contributed $16.5 million or 1pt of growth').
controles.correction_proposee: Ecrire 'un gain non monetaire de 227,0 M$ sur des actifs numeriques, exclu par la societe de ses mesures ajustees' plutot que 'un gain non recurrent'. La reevaluation a la juste valeur peut se reproduire, a la hausse comme a la baisse.

controles.affirmation: FONDAMENTAL 2 - Goodwill + incorporels + couts differes = environ 65% du total des actifs
controles.verbatim_source: Goodwill, intangible assets, net, and deferred client conversion and start-up costs accounted for approximately 65% of the total assets on our balance sheet as of June 30, 2026.
FISCAL YEAR 2026 BUSINESS COMBINATIONS : CQG (April 2026), Acolin Group Holdco Limited (January 2026), LDI-MAP LLC / iJoin (September 2025), Signal Agency Limited (August 2025) = 4.

controles.affirmation: FONDAMENTAL 2 - 'une partie de la croissance de ses segments les plus rentables vient directement de ces rachats'
controles.verbatim_source: Les acquisitions citees (SIS, CQG) alimentent le segment Global Technology and Operations, qui est le MOINS rentable des deux segments : GTO 'Pre-tax Margin 15.5 % 11.3 %' contre ICS 'Pre-tax Margin 19.8 % 20.6 %'. Le 10-K ne qualifie nulle part GTO de segment le plus rentable.
controles.correction_proposee: Remplacer 'ses segments les plus rentables' par 'son segment technologie et operations (GTO), le moins rentable des deux (marge avant impot 15,5% contre 19,8% pour ICS)' ou simplement 'ses activites les plus dynamiques'.

controles.affirmation: FONDAMENTAL EXTERNE 1 - revenus de distribution 2 250,6 M$ sur 7 476,8 M$ de CA total, soit environ 30%, en hausse de 9%
controles.verbatim_source: Distribution revenues 2,250.6 2,062.0 188.7 9 ; Total $ 7,476.8 $ 6,889.1 $ 587.6 9 (soit 30,1%) ; 'Distribution revenues increased $188.7 million, or 9%, primarily driven by the postage rate increases of approximately $123 million and higher volumes'
controles.correction_proposee: Nuance : les revenus de distribution ne sont pas 100% postaux. Verbatim : 'Distribution revenues primarily include revenues related to the physical mailing of proxy materials, interim communications, transaction reporting, customer communications and fulfillment services as well as administrative services related to our fund processing solutions'. Ecrire 'principalement lies a l'envoi physique' au lieu de 'lies a l'envoi physique'.

controles.affirmation: FONDAMENTAL EXTERNE 1 - preuve citee entre guillemets : 'changes in postal rates or shipping costs...may result in decreased demand for our traditional printed and mailed communications'
controles.verbatim_source: In addition, future increases in postal rates or shipping costs, as well as changes in customer preferences, may result in decreased demand for our traditional printed and mailed communications resulting in an adverse effect on our business, financial condition and results of operations.
controles.correction_proposee: Citation non litterale : le document dit 'future increases in postal rates' (hausses futures) et non 'changes in postal rates', et l'element supprime par les points de suspension est 'as well as changes in customer preferences', pas une reference au numerique. Restituer le verbatim exact et remplacer 'un basculement accelere vers le numerique' par 'une evolution des preferences des clients'.

controles.affirmation: FONDAMENTAL EXTERNE 2 - gestion de patrimoine +10 a 11% dont 5 pts de SIS ; marches de capitaux +5 a 6% dont 1 pt de CQG
controles.verbatim_source: By product line, Recurring revenue growth and Recurring revenue growth constant currency (Non-GAAP) were as follows: Capital markets rose 6% and 5%, respectively, driven by 4pts of organic growth and 1pt from the acquisition of CQG. ... Wealth and investment management rose 11% and 10%, respectively, driven by 5pts of Organic growth and 5pts from the acquisition of SIS.
controles.correction_proposee: Precision utile : ces pourcentages portent sur les REVENUS RECURRENTS de ces lignes de produits, pas sur leur chiffre d'affaires total, et le second chiffre est la version a taux de change constant. Preciser 'revenus recurrents' dans l'argument.

controles.affirmation: QUANTITATIF 1 - marge operationnelle ajustee 20,5% en 2026 comme en 2025 ; marge GAAP 17,4% contre 17,3% ; CA +9%
controles.verbatim_source: Operating income margin (GAAP) 17.4 % 17.3 % ; Adjusted Operating income margin (Non-GAAP) 20.5 % 20.5 % ; Total $ 7,476.8 $ 6,889.1 $ 587.6 9

controles.affirmation: QUANTITATIF 2 - BPA dilue ajuste 9,60 $ contre 8,55 $ (+12,3%) ; BPA dilue GAAP 9,60 $ contre 7,10 $ (+35,2%)
controles.verbatim_source: Diluted earnings per share (GAAP) $ 9.60 $ 7.10 ; Adjusted earnings per share (Non-GAAP) $ 9.60 $ 8.55 ; tableau MD&A : 9.60 $ 7.10 $ 2.50 35

controles.affirmation: QUANTITATIF 3 - plus de 18 000 Mds$ de transactions tokenisees et traditionnelles traitees en moyenne par jour sur l'exercice 2026
controles.verbatim_source: In fiscal year 2026, we: ... processed on average over $18 trillion in tokenized and traditional securities trades per day

controles.affirmation: QUANTITATIF 3 - perspective : 'Ce volume record accompagne des marches de capitaux particulierement actifs sur la periode'
controles.verbatim_source: Le 10-K FY2026 ne qualifie ce volume ni de record ni de lie a des marches particulierement actifs. Le 10-K FY2025 mentionne 'processed on average over $15 trillion in equity and fixed income trades per day' : le perimetre a change (equity et fixed income en 2025, tokenized and traditional securities en 2026), donc la comparaison 15 vs 18 n'etablit pas un record a perimetre constant.
controles.correction_proposee: Supprimer le mot 'record' ou ecrire 'Ce volume, en hausse par rapport aux plus de 15 000 Mds$ par jour indiques pour l'exercice 2025 sur un perimetre toutefois different'.
